title: Non-targeting pooled siRNA transfected cells with vehicle (0.001% EtOH) treatment well 1
characteristics_ch1: tissue: endometrial stromal cells | treatment: vehicle (0.001% EtOH) | sirna: Non-targeting pooled siRNA
treatment_protocol_ch1: The cells were transfected with each siRNA in OPTI-MEM medium for 48 hr and the medium was replaced with either vehicle or 2 nM of 1,25(OH)2D3 for 24 hr in OPTI-MEM containing 2% v/v charcoal-stripped fetal bovine serum.
growth_protocol_ch1: The cells were cultured and distributed into a 6-well plate in DMEM/F12 containing 10% v/v fetal bovine serum, 100 units/mL penicillin, and 100 ug/mL streptomycin.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted by TRIzol and cleaned up using the Qiagen RNAeasy Kit | RNA libraries were prepared by the Illumina Tru-Seq mRNA kit
